meta.title: Advertised range straddles the going rate

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer
Quenby Applications Ltd · Clerkenwell, London

Quenby builds citizen-reporting tools for UK local councils: potholes, fly-tipping, streetlights. Residents report; our routing gets the right crew there with the right kit.

You'd work across a Django backend and a React Native app used by 60 councils' field teams, with a fortnightly release train and real accessibility requirements.

We'd like 1-3 years of experience and one example of making software humane for non-technical users.

The range is £36,000-£41,000 depending on experience. Visa sponsorship is available for this role. 26 days holiday, civic-tech conference budget, bikes in the basement. Two interviews and a reference chat.

expected.determining_fact: The advertised range straddles the £38,300 going rate: an offer in the lower part of the band could not be sponsored and one in the upper part could — sponsorability depends on the actual offer, which the posting does not fix.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: Visa sponsorship is available for this role

design_notes: Authoring-addition archetype (veto at label pass by deleting the case): the straddling range is the true positive for the straddles_floor reason — without it that enum value is untestable. An optimistic solver anchors on £41,000 and issues a false SPONSORABLE; a pessimistic one anchors low and discards the role. The honest answer names the number to negotiate past.
